data.name: Rufaydah
data.gender_notes: Rufaydah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rufaydah is an Arabic name for girls that means 'increase', 'augmentation'. It comes from the R-F-D root which is used in the Quran in Surat Al-Imran verse 193. The name Rufaydah carries the meaning “Augmentation, increase” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rufaydah usually hope their child will grow to embody augmentation, increase and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying growth and progress in one's faith and in life.
data.etymology: Rufaydah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Augmentation, increase.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rufaydah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: رفيدة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الرفد والمساعدة والنصرة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رفعيدة مشتق من الفعل رَفَدَ، ويعني الرفد والمساعدة والنصرة. ورد ذكره في اللغة العربية والثقافة الإسلامية كاسم للإناث، يوحي بالعطاء والدعم والمساندة.

in_urdu.name: رفیدہ
in_urdu.meaning: رفیدہ کا مطلب ہے مدد کرنا، سپورٹ کرنا، اور تعاون کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: رفیدہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مدد کرنا، سپورٹ کرنا، اور تعاون کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں، جو اس کی خوبصورتی اور گہرے معنی کی وجہ سے اسے پسند کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रफ़ीदा
in_hindi.meaning: रफ़ीदा का अर्थ है मदद करना, समर्थन करना और सहयोग करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: रफ़ीदा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है मदद करना, समर्थन करना और सहयोग करना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है, जो इसकी सुंदरता और गहरे अर्थ के कारण इसे पसंद करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: رفیډه
in_pashto.meaning: رفیډه د مرستې، مالتړ او همکارۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: رفیډه نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د مرستې، مالتړ او همکارۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره ځانګړی اهمیت لري، ځکه چې دا د مرستې او همکارۍ مفهوم منعکس کوي.

in_english.name: Rufaydah
in_english.meaning: Rufaydah means to help, support, or assist in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Rufaydah is an Arabic-originated name that signifies help, support, or assistance. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'R-F-D', it connotes the act of providing aid or backing. Historically, the name holds significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting values of charity, benevolence, and community support.

It is a reminder of the continuous cycle of growth and transformation that is inherent in our spiritual journey. It encourages us to strive for self-improvement and spiritual increase, as emphasized in Hadith and Quranic verses. data.spiritual_symbolism: Rufaydah: The radiant and enlightening one, whose light illuminates the path to wisdom and knowledge.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hisham, Sirah Ibn Hisham, p. 569 The name Rufaydah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Rufaydah bint Al-Harith was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and was known for her generosity and hospitality. She was the mother of Umar ibn Al-Khattab, the second caliph of Islam.
